title: UFO 'like a rainbow' spotted streaking across night sky
description: Multiple streaks of light have been seen moving across the night sky.

title: Choose Your Own Adventure Revives Classic Sci-Fi Quest 'Inside UFO 54-40'
description: The iconic interactive fiction series, Choose Your Own Adventure, has re-released the 1982 classic 'Inside UFO 54-40'. Readers take on the role of an abducted airplane passenger thrust into a galactic search for the utopian planet Ultima, navigating 30 possible endings in a tale of space exploration and decision-making.

title: Pentagon Makes Major Change To UFO Disclosure Rules For Military, Government Employees
War Dept Waives Secrecy Rules for UAP Disclosures
description: The Department of War on Tuesday announced a new legal waiver allowing current and former government personnel and contractors to provide protected information about unidentified anomalous phenomena to officials leading the Trump administration's UAP disclosure effort.
